biography.plain_text: Victor Bared is an American marine-services entrepreneur, commercial developer and president of Miami’s Jones Boat Yard. With his nephew Jose Bared, he acquired and expanded the longstanding Miami River yard into a facility serving large vessels, adding repair capacity and waterfront property. His business interests have also included aviation maintenance and property investment.

long_biography.plain_text:
Jones Boat Yard became Victor Bared’s central operating business after he and Jose Bared bought the Miami River facility and neighbouring properties. As president, Bared oversaw investment in dry docks, workshops and marine trades intended to serve increasingly large vessels while retaining work for smaller craft.

The Bareds also pursued waterfront development around the yard, combining repair, storage and crew services with plans for a broader marine complex. Victor Bared’s other documented interests include commercial property and aircraft repair. His role at Jones has joined ownership with hands-on expansion of a long-established Miami marine business.
